caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a wooden cabinet rendered in shades of brown and pink. The composition consists of three views: a front elevation on the left, a side elevation on the right, and a sectional top view at the top left corner. The front elevation shows the cabinet supported by four thick, turned legs with a lower shelf. The base includes two rectangular drawers, each with a single round knob in the center, set beneath a row of vertical, spindle-shaped wooden decorations. Above this, the main cabinet body consists of three compartments, the left and right featuring square panels with concentric diamond shapes, and the central section containing two small square panels at the bottom, vertical decorative columns, and an arched center panel with a hanging tassel-like decoration. The upper and lower edges of the main cabinet section display zigzag or notched decorative trim. The side elevation shows the cabinet's depth, highlighting the thickness of the legs and the boxy structure of the side panels, which also feature inset geometric decorations. The sectional top view displays the layout and internal support structure of the cabinet. In the upper right corner, the scale "1/8 in. = 1 inch" is inscribed. The entire drawing is bordered by a thin black line, and the background is a light beige color.
title: Court Chest
